intro: Fizzle Brassbolts is a prominent gnomish engineer stationed out on the baked salt flats of the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. Alongside his rival, the goblin Pozzik, Fizzle co-founded the raceway to pit gnomish precision engineering against reckless goblin ingenuity in high-speed rocket car races. He constantly seeks parts, fuel, and strange desert reagents to keep his racing team running.

sections.t: A Matter of Principle and Pistons
p: Out in the shimmering heat of the Shimmering Flats, political alliances and ancient grudges yield to the roar of motorized engines. Fizzle Brassbolts arrived here with one goal in mind: proving once and for all that gnomish craftsmanship is vastly superior to crude goblin tinkering. Together with his goblin counterpart Pozzik, he helped lay out the Mirage Raceway, bringing race cars, pit crews, and spectators to an otherwise desolate basin.

Racing across dry salt beds at breakneck speeds requires constant improvisation. As an avid member of the Mechanical Engineers' Guild of Azeroth (MEGA), Fizzle does not shy away from unorthodox experiments. Whether testing volatile mixtures concocted from local creature venom or contracting travelers to fetch replacement mechanical parts, Fizzle is determined to keep his driver's wheels turning faster than any explosive goblin contraption.
